summary: Gufic Biosciences has appointed Reeta Shah to its board as a non-executive independent director. Independent directors provide objective oversight and governance for listed companies. headline: Gufic Biosciences acquires a luxury duplex in Juhu's Lodha Avalon project for ₹236 crore
hook: Pharma firm buys luxury Mumbai duplex
summary: Pharmaceutical company Gufic has purchased a high-end duplex in Lodha Developers' luxury Mumbai project, Lodha Avalon, located in Juhu, for ₹236 crore. This transaction adds to a series of high-value real estate deals at the project, which has increasingly attracted pharmaceutical promoters and top business executives. For an Indian retail investor, luxury residential property purchases by corporate entities highlight cash deployment trends within the promoter-driven pharmaceutical sector.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates high-value cash deployment by pharmaceutical promoters into luxury real estate

headline: Gufic Biosciences explains special window for physical share transfers

summary: Gufic Biosciences has outlined the procedure for a special window regarding physical share transfers. This regulatory compliance update affects shareholders holding shares in physical form. Investors holding physical certificates must understand the required documentation and timelines to complete the transfer process. Indian retail investors holding physical shares in the company need to review these guidelines to avoid processing delays.
why_it_matters: Physical share holders must act within the designated transfer window.
